title: Surreal Clock Tower
description: A large round clock with hands and numbers sits on a tall tower atop a green hill with a path inside a big green circle. The setting shows floating colorful spheres, butterflies, bats, a sun, and rocky formations against a pale background.
prompt: surreal painting of a tall clock tower with round clock face on a green hill with winding path inside a large green circle floating in the air. colorful spheres and orbs float around it along with an orange butterfly, blue butterfly, bats, and a small sun. rocky formations float below the circle against a pale beige and green background.
